Rhea L.: idea: 15m pricing sprint demo next Tue — reveal the new calculator and run a quick gating test + FAQ variant. keep it sharp.
Omar N.: agree. what are we optimizing for? demo-bookings or self-serve starts?
Rhea L.: primary = demo bookings from larger accounts; secondary = increase calc starts on-site.
Keiko T.: test plan: Variant 1 = full inline calc + short FAQ. Variant 2 = advanced estimator gated by email (ask company size) + long FAQ. split traffic 50/50.
Omar N.: routing rule: if domain in target_list OR company_size>500 => tag:priority_sdr. ops-bot: suggested rule created "priority_sdr_rule"
ops-bot: event created: "pricing-sprint-demo-2976543210" and rule "tag:webinar_inbound" applied to registrations
Keiko T.: microcopy drafts: Committed -> "Stable monthly pricing", "Reserved capacity", "SLA". Metered -> "Pay per token", "Scale to zero", "Cost tips". short for mobile.
Rhea L.: slide narrative (benchmarks): one line: "Optimized configs cut per-token spend ~30% while keeping 95th-pct latency inside our SLO for steady workloads." Keiko will refine.
Omar N.: tracking: UTM=pricing-sprint-2976543210. page CTAs: Try calculator (no gate) vs Advanced estimator (gated).

<iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-sprint-2976543210&variant=1" width="100%" height="540"></iframe>
